node_definition.done_when: At base the budget block of the flight schema has no slot for pace_multiple or drain_lead_hours, so with extra keys forbidden a layer setting either raises the unknown-key refusal, while tests/test_pace.py passes only because it feeds a plain mapping. Done when a configuration layer carrying budget.pace_multiple: 2.2 and budget.drain_lead_hours: 24.0 resolves through the project's own flight resolver and pace.policy(resolved) reports pace_multiple 2.2 and drain_lead_hours 24.0; the shipped defaults declare the documented pair; reckon/_flight_schema.py and docs/_shared/flight.schema.json are regenerated by scripts/regen_flight_schema.py in the same commit as the YAML, never hand-edited. Measured files: tests/test_pace.py plus every existing test file that loads the flight schema or its defaults, named in the manifest. Tests run under a temporary config home with the real config home asserted untouched. At least one added assertion must fail at the dispatch base, shown in a log. Zero added failures against base over the measured files in ONE invocation. Report ruff findings on the staged paths against the count at base.
